$comment: Phase 26 (0.2.6) fully-featured-coding-agent-readiness scope gate and evidence record. Machine-readable source of truth for plans/026-Release-0-2-6-Fully-Featured-Coding-Agent-Readiness.md: the nine implementation items (primitive review; host-selected PTY backend; indexed/semantic search seam; multi-worktree/repository workspace lifecycle; demand-gated forge breadth; durable process/ACP recovery; bounded patch review + incremental diagnostics; protected real coding journey; docs finalization + 0.2.6 bump + exit gate) with per-task evidence tokens, allowed files, content markers, the demand registry (gitlab-forge and bitbucket-forge deferred at Task 0 — activation requires a named consumer), the frozen state machines and caps, the T1-T8 threat model mapped to task tests, the additive-only compat policy (expected deltas: version literal 0.2.5 -> 0.2.6 plus additive exports; removedOrChanged 0; no --allow-break without an amended migration-backed decision), the protected-gate policy (missing credentials/infrastructure records blocked and fails the release gate, never a passing skip), migration tokens, and the deviation log. Baseline evidence for the exit gate lives in scripts/phase26-baseline.json (exitGate null until Task 8 records it green). Support matrix stays frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json; 0.2.6 changes none of it.
baseline: 0.2.5 (plan 025 exit gate green 2026-08-15; signed tag v0.2.5 + npm OIDC publication pending operator handoff; 50 publishable manifests; audit 0; HEAD 496d021)

items.title: Primitive review, capability freeze, demand registry, threat model, baseline, owners, migration, budgets
items.rationale: Task 0 of plan 026: inventory existing primitives (ProcessSessions, OutputAccumulator, ExecutionPolicy, CheckpointStore, LeaseStore, ToolEffectStore, AgentRunLifecycle, AcpSessionStore, RepositoryOperations, GitOperations, coding checkpoints, ArtifactService, LanguageIntelligence, lifecycle events, browser/sandbox primitives, packed journey, release evidence), approve only generic gaps, freeze states/caps/errors/demand/protected envs, capture the 0.2.5 baseline with seam hashes, and wire the freeze test into npm test. No source edited.

items.title: Host-selected PTY and interactive ProcessSession backend
items.rationale: Task 1 of plan 026 (roadmap bullet 1): optional host ptyBackend with bounded resize and terminal metadata routed through the existing ProcessSessions state machine; pty:true without backend keeps ERR_PRISM_PROCESS_PTY_UNSUPPORTED before spawn; non-PTY path byte-compatible. Process types/sessions/index/limits/docs are shared coordination files (multiple editors).

items.title: Scalable incremental indexed and semantic repository-search seam
items.rationale: Task 2 of plan 026 (roadmap bullet 2): host index contract (update/remove/search/status/dispose) with states empty|building|ready|stale|failed; repo_search stays bounded literal by default; indexed_literal/semantic modes explicit; no silent downgrade; results validated, containment-checked, labeled untrusted_index.

items.title: Ownership-scoped multi-repository and worktree lifecycle
items.rationale: Task 3 of plan 026 (roadmap bullet 3): checkpoint/lease-backed coding workspace lifecycle over existing GitOperations; versioned record namespace; main worktree immutable; dirty/locked/unowned cleanup refuses unless host-authorized; identity/fingerprint revalidation on resume; Postgres conformance leg shared with Task 5.

items.title: Demand-gated forge breadth (GitLab or Bitbucket only)
items.rationale: Task 4 of plan 026 (roadmap bullet 4): at most one adapter behind a named consumer in the demand registry; deferred at Task 0 so no adapter source, docs page, or export may exist; activation flips demand status first and records the consumer.

items.title: Durable ACP/live-task and managed-process recovery across restarts and replicas
items.rationale: Task 5 of plan 026 (roadmap bullet 5): metadata-only durable records via CheckpointStore + LeaseStore fencing; attach-if-attested else atomic unknown; ACP activeRun references; durable cancellation never replays tools; core files (contracts-run-state, agent-run-state, checkpoints, leases, tool-effects, agent-run-lifecycle) are preservedSurface and may only change via a recorded deviation.

items.title: Bounded patch review and incremental LSP/check diagnostics workflow
items.rationale: Task 6 of plan 026 (roadmap bullet 6): review manifest binds decisions to artifact revision + patch digest + repository/worktree/base/head; LSP didChange sync with monotonic versions + push/pull refresh + normalized diagnosticDelta; host check parsers; ArtifactService remains the approval store (server/src/artifacts.ts untouched unless a recorded deviation).

items.title: Protected real coding-agent release journey
securityTests: T7 credential leak -> phase26-coding-journey.test.mjs leak scan
items.rationale: Task 7 of plan 026 (roadmap bullet 7): packed-consumer protected journey over real Docker/browser/provider/forge/Postgres/PTY with unique run suffix, idempotent cleanup, restart/replica recovery, cancellation, and blocked-not-green release accounting. scripts/phase26-coding-journey-report.json is generated evidence (absent until the journey runs).

items.title: Documentation finalization, 0.2.6 bump, compatibility review, and exit gate
items.rationale: Task 8 of plan 026: docs/navigation finalization, scripted 0.2.5 -> 0.2.6 bump across 50 manifests, additive compat review, full default + protected gate run, phase26-baseline.json exitGate green with blocked false, signed v0.2.6 + npm OIDC operator handoff. roadmap.md is byte-immutable until this task (single editor).

threats.title: Hostile terminal: escape/control sequences, oversized dimensions/TERM/input, resize flood, secret leakage, backend loss/spoofing
threats.posture: PTY output stays untrusted data; caps enforced before backend calls; wrong owner/policy -> no backend mutation; absent/unsupported backend -> pre-spawn error; redaction on errors/events/metadata

threats.title: Malicious or stale index: cross-tenant/cross-root results, prompt-injection snippets, malformed scores/ids, silent semantic downgrade, unbounded query/update
threats.posture: Results validated, containment-checked, labeled untrusted_index; stale/failed/unsupported -> stable error; no implicit fallback that changes query meaning; byte/result/timeout caps

threats.title: Workspace lifecycle: cross-tenant path/symlink escape, main-worktree removal, dirty/locked force cleanup, identity/fingerprint collision, stale fence writes
threats.posture: Canonicalized roots; CAS + lease fencing; main worktree immutable; dirty/locked/unowned refuse unless host-authorized; partial -> unknown reconcilable; credential URLs never stored

threats.title: Forge: token leak into argv/logs/events/artifacts, duplicate mutation, wrong repository, rate-limit/stale-head races, redirect/SSRF, cross-tenant use
threats.posture: Per-call least-privilege credentials via env injection; ToolEffectStore idempotency; lookup-before-create; stale head refused; bounded transport; deferral when no demand

threats.title: Recovery split-brain: duplicate attach/input/kill/cancel, stale fence, orphan process, fabricated exit, duplicate approval/effect, credential fields in records
threats.posture: Lease + fence single-winner; attach only when attested else atomic unknown; no PID probing; cancellation never replays tools; records redacted/versioned; cross-store conformance without timing sleeps

threats.title: Patch review: TOCTOU between review and apply, stale acceptance after patch/identity change, diagnostic spoof/overflow, path escape, secret leakage
threats.posture: Decisions bind to digest + revision + repository/worktree/base/head; change -> superseded; diagnostics versioned/bounded; raw patch/check bodies never persisted; projection allow-list gated

threats.title: Journey: credential/artifact leak, failed cleanup (open PR/branch/worktree/container/context/unknown process), skipped-required-infra passes as green
threats.posture: Secrets late-bound and excluded from report/stdout/artifacts; cleanup idempotent and required; missing infra -> blocked fails release; leak scan gates evidence

threats.title: Implicit activation/resource abuse: optional capability active by default, unbounded sessions/index/records/journey, import-time sweeper, package budget drift
threats.posture: All seams default unavailable/deny; caps frozen per task; freeze test locks pending files byte-identical; budget gate + protected accounting

expectedDeltas: additive exports: PTY backend/handle, indexed-search seam, workspace lifecycle, process/ACP recovery, review manifest + diagnostics, (forge adapter only if demanded)

deviations.what: T3 stale-fence test mapping: the Task 0 manifest mapped T3's stale-fence test to scripts/phase26-recovery-conformance.test.mjs, which is a task5-owned single-editor file that must stay absent while task5 is pending. Flipping task3 done would fail the freeze threat-existence check. T3's mapped tests now reference only the task3-owned workspace-lifecycle.test.ts, whose lease/CAS fencing suite (held-lease rejection, ownership mismatch, monotonic fencing-token CAS) covers the stale-fence threat at unit level; the frozen Postgres two-replica fence leg ships in the task5 conformance file per plan 026 Task 3/5 test cases.
deviations.review: Manifest threat mapping adjusted to respect single-editor ownership; no cap, state machine, compat, or API change; the Postgres conformance leg remains frozen for task5.

deviations.what: Task 0 recorded the two new task5 test files under packages/coding-agent/src/process/__tests__/ and packages/ag-ui/src/acp/__tests__/, but no such test directories exist in either package: the package test scripts glob dist/__tests__/*.test.js, so tests under those paths would compile but never run. Both tests live in the packages' real test directories (packages/coding-agent/src/__tests__/process-recovery.test.ts and packages/ag-ui/src/__tests__/acp-recovery.test.ts); the manifest allowedFiles and baseline seams were updated to those paths. No cap, state machine, compat, or API change; the test content is unchanged.
deviations.review: Path correction only; test discovery verified by running both suites from dist/__tests__.

deviations.what: Task 7's packed journey integration exposed a shape mismatch in the Task 6 review helper: the server ArtifactRecord carries the artifact id as `id` (src/artifacts.ts), while assertCodingPatchAccepted compared `artifact.artifactId` which never exists on the real record, throwing ERR_PRISM_REVIEW_OWNERSHIP for every real attach. Fixed review.ts to read `artifact.id` (CodingReviewArtifactRecord.id, documented against ArtifactRecord.id) and updated review.test.ts recordFor/ownership mocks to the real shape; no cap/state-machine/API change to the manifest surface. review.ts + review.test.ts are outside Task 7's frozen allowedFiles, so this deviation records the amendment.
deviations.review: Real-record integration proof: the patch-review journey leg (server createArtifactService over Postgres + assertCodingPatchAccepted) now derives pending -> accepted -> superseded against the actual ArtifactRecord shape; unit suite 13/13.
